Request

Request Address

POST/api/v2/shop/get_shop_info

Base URL: https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/shop/get_shop_info

Common Request Parameters

NameTypeRequiredSampleDescription

access_tokenstringFalsec09222e3fc40ffb25fc947f738b1abf1The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.
shop_idintFalse600000Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.
signstringFalsee318d3e932719916a9f9ebb57e2011961bd47abfa54a36e040d050d8931596e2Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. Response

Response Parameters

NameTypeRequiredSampleDescription
shop_namestringFalseopenapi_pshop_1Name of the shop.
regionstringFalseTWShop's area.
statusstringFalseNORMAL<p>Applicable status: <b>BANNED</b>, <b>FROZEN</b>, <b>NORMAL</b>.</p>
sip_affi_shopsobject[]FalseSIP affiliate shops info list.If you request for SIP primary shop,this field will be returned, if you request for SIP affiliate shop,this field won't be returned
is_cbbooleanFalsetrueUse this filed to indicate whether the shop is a cross-border shop.
request_idstringFalse0b8f39a76e6ada92247b416c768363eeThe identifier for an API request for error tracking.
auth_timetimestampFalse1610533441The timestamp when the shop was authorized to the partner.
expire_timetimestampFalse1642069441Use this field to indicate the expiration date for shop authorization.
is_sipbooleanFalsetrueThis filed will return "true" when SIP primary shop or affiliate shop calls
is_upgraded_cbscbooleanFalsetrue<p>Use this filed to indicate whether this merchant is upgraded to CBSC, including CNSC and KRSC.<br /></p>
merchant_idint64False1000000400<p>Shopee’s unique identifier for a merchant. If the shop won't under any merchant, then the value will be null.<br /></p>
shop_fulfillment_flagstringFalsePFF - 3PF Shop<p>Use this field to indicate the fulfillment type of current shop, the applicable values: </p><p><b><br /></b></p><p><b>- Pure - FBS Shop: </b>Single mode, refer to Local/CB shops which only have Shopee official warehouse stock, orders are fulfilled by Shopee from Shopee official warehouse; </p><p><b><br /></b></p><p><b>- Pure - 3PF Shop: </b>Single mode, refer to CB shops which only have local seller warehouse stock, orders are fulfilled by seller from local seller warehouse via local logistics channels; </p><p><b><br /></b></p><p><b>- PFF - FBS Shop: </b></p><p>1) Hybird mode, refer to Local shops which have both Shopee official warehouse stock and local seller warehouse stock, orders can be fulfilled by Shopee from Shopee official warehouse and can also fulfilled by seller from local seller warehouse via local logistics channels; </p><p>2) Hybrid mode, refer to CB shops which have both Shopee official warehouse stock and CB seller warehouse stock, orders can be fulfilled by Shopee from Shopee official warehouse and can also fulfilled by seller from CB seller warehouse via CB logistics channels; </p><p><b><br /></b></p><p><b>- PFF - 3PF Shop: </b>Hybrid mode, refer to CB shops which have both local seller warehouse stock and CB seller warehouse stock, orders can be fulfilled by seller from local seller warehouse via local logistics channels and can also fulfilled by seller from CB seller warehouse via CB logistics channels; </p><p><br /></p><p><b>- LFF Hybrid Shop:</b> Hybrid mode, refer to CB shops which have 3 types of stock: FBS stock (Shopee official warehouse stock), 3PF stock (CB seller own stock in the local market) and CB SLS stock (CB seller own stock in CN/HK/KR);</p><p><b><br /></b></p><p><b>- Others</b></p><p><b><br /></b></p><p><b>- Unknown: </b>Returned when obtaining shop_fulfillment_flag information fails</p>
is_main_shopbooleanFalsetrue<p>Identifies if the current shop is a Local Shop linked to Cross Border Direct Shop.</p>
is_direct_shopbooleanFalsefalse<p>Identifies if the current shop is a Cross Border Direct Shop.</p>
linked_main_shop_idint64False0<p>Returns the Shop ID of the Local Shop linked to the Cross Border Direct Shop.</p>
linked_direct_shop_listobject[]False<p>Returns the list of Cross Border Direct Shops linked to the Local Shop.</p>
is_one_awbbooleanFalsetrue<p>Use this filed to indicate if the shop is in 1-AWB whitelist. </p><p><br /></p><p>If is_one_awb return true, please use new AWB size (10cm x 15cm thermal paper) to print AWB. For more details, please refer to: <a href="https://open.shopee.com/announcements/1138?category=3&is_top=false" target="_blank" style="font-size:14px;">https://open.shopee.com/announcements/1138?category=3&is_top=false</a></p>
is_mart_shopbooleanFalsefalse<p>Indicates whether the current shop is a Mart Shop.<br /></p>
is_outlet_shopbooleanFalsefalse<p>Indicates whether the current shop is an Outlet Shop.<br /></p>
mart_shop_idint64False1234567890<p>(Only returned when requesting an Outlet Shop) Refers to the Mart Shop ID this Outlet belongs to.<br /></p>
outlet_shop_info_listobject[]False<p>(Only returned when requesting a Mart Shop) List of Outlet Shop IDs under this Mart Shop.<br /></p>
mart_outlet_structure_typestringFalsewarehouse_mart_shop<p>(Only returned when requesting a Mart or Outlet Shop)<br /></p><p><span style="font-size:14px;">Indicates the structure type of the Mart or Outlet shop. Applicable values are: </span><b>normal_mart_shop, warehouse_mart_shop, normal_outlet_shop, warehouse_outlet_shop</b></p>
